reasonForResult: One critical violation found: EXCESSIVE DRINKING PROMOTION — The front label prominently displays 'LIVE BIG. DRINK MORE. MAKE EVERY NIGHT EPIC.' This constitutes a prohibited excessive drinking claim under TTB labeling regulations. The phrase 'DRINK MORE' explicitly encourages increased alcohol consumption, and the combination with 'MAKE EVERY NIGHT EPIC' promotes a pattern of regular excessive drinking, both of which are expressly prohibited. All other mandatory elements are present and correctly formatted: the government warning appears with both required sections, the importer statement reads 'Imported by Vivere Imports, LLC, Miami, FL 33131', country of origin is 'Product of Italy', alcohol content is 'ALC. 13.5% BY VOL.', net contents are 750 mL, and sulfites disclosure is present.
